prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only eight categories have at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, sign-in reordering, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful, each yielding at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, resulting in negative effects or no clear effect across multiple tests.
Path choice copy and home wait info changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, especially for redesigns.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like sign-in reordering and path choice hints.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Multi-Choice Preview Hint: Displays a helpful tip banner explaining how path options customize pet traits and desktop behaviors right under the path choices. (why: Dropoff at choose_path is 22.2% with a long mean duration (514s); path choice hints previously yielded successful test results.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Desktop Behavior Setup Screen: Adds a new interactive setup screen after home_intro where users configure screen docking preferences and hotkey controls before completing setup. (why: Support received 3 separate emails complaining of confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Post Waiting Stage Reorder: Moves the sign_in screen after the waiting stage, allowing users to experience pet rendering before asking for account authentication. (why: Sign-in reordering was identified as an effective mechanism, and asking for sign-in after user investment reduces dropoff.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Pet Account Notice: Adds a clear hint on the sign_in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account method to retain existing pets. (why: Top support theme (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating account confusion during login.)
4: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Sound Selection Flow: Embeds dynamic audio sample components into the pet selection screen so users can listen to pet sound effects while choosing. (why: Adoption has the largest single dropoff rate (30.2%) with median time 89s; interactive feedback enhances motivation during adoption.)
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Activity Progress Tips: Adds a tip carousel to the waiting screen displaying key desktop control tips while pet assets render in the background. (why: The waiting stage on home has high mean duration (2336s), and users frequently ask how to interact with pets after setup.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Quick Desktop Command Bar: Switches home_intro to a compact layout with an integrated checklist showing keyboard shortcuts for hiding and talking to the desktop pet. (why: Finish step dropoff is 26.9%, and multiple support tickets reflect confusion over basic desktop pet controls.)
7: [adoption, hint] Adoption Photo Failure Guidance Info: Adds explicit quality and format requirements to the photo upload screen to prevent custom pet generation failures. (why: Support received 3 complaints about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.)
8: [home, notification] Waiting Screen System Readiness Notification: Enables desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their desktop pet finished loading while the window was backgrounded. (why: Home wait time has a very high mean (2336s), leading users to minimize the app and suffer dropoffs or launch confusion.)
